summary: P01 V2.47.223 is the Software one-page Production R6 mature visual reconstruction after Owner rejected V2.47.222 UI maturity. It removes the oversized dashboard-style hero and duplicate hero statistics, enlarges and rebalances search/profile/action controls, unifies filter presentation, removes the giant boxed directory container, improves software-card readability and selected-state clarity, and uses 3/4/5 responsive columns instead of over-compressed 4/5/6. The approved one-page IA, canonical Start data authority, schema, authentication/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state and Production runtime remain unchanged. Production remains Owner-manual.
